target: dislocation definition, docs/DECISIONS.md:110-117 (PI 2026-10-27: best-fit rigid motion of all cage nodes, radial outward translation, 1 mm / 0.5 mm posterior) and docs/PLAN.md:35 (S9 still says 'cage-centre translation'); S1 (PLAN.md:27) checked only 'by construction' before loading
claim: The new dislocation measure averages over all nodes, so it reports the share of the cage that moves, not how far the moving part goes. Anything the cage does without moving its centroid is invisible. On a synthetic cage at p062 size, all of the following PASS the rule (1 mm any direction, 0.5 mm posterior): (1) a rigid 10 deg spin about the vertical axis: reported 0.009 mm, while corners move 1.21 mm, 0.80 mm of it posterior; (2) the posterior 10 % of the volume sliding 4.5 mm toward the cord: reported 0.48 mm posterior; (3) the anterior 25 % sliding 3.5 mm out of the disc space toward the oesophagus: reported 0.88 mm. Case 2 is only caught if the separate 'canal clearance' nerve check exists. That check is not defined (no zone geometry, no code). Case 3 is caught by nothing: S1 'stays in the disc space' is enforced only on the undeformed voxels, and no rule checks the loaded shape against the disc-space boundary except posteriorly. A designer can make this happen on purpose: a stiff, well-anchored core plus soft, poorly held lobes (allowed: phi in [0, 1] per voxel, S3 needs only one connected part). The node-equal weighting also means that adding anchored volume dilutes the reported migration of a loose part. Also: the rotation part of the rigid fit has no limit, and 'radial outward from the disc-space centre' is undefined when the cage centroid sits at that centre (the direction comes only from the motion itself). PLAN.md S9 was not updated (it still says cage-centre translation). No code implements either version (no constraints.py in the repository), so no number reported so far has used the definition.
evidence: Script work/agents/redteam/r0003_dislocation.py -> work/agents/redteam/r0003_dislocation_result.json (Kabsch / Horn least-squares rigid fit, equal node weights, 0.2 mm grid block 11 x 8.5 x 4.6 mm, 66 k nodes; imposed displacements, not simulated). Results: spin_5deg reported 0.004 mm, corners 0.61 mm (0.38 posterior); spin_10deg 0.009 mm, corners 1.21 mm (0.80 posterior); anterior_lobe_15pct_4.0mm 0.64 mm; anterior_lobe_25pct_3.5mm 0.875 mm; posterior_lobe_8pct_4.0mm 0.357 mm posterior; posterior_lobe_10pct_4.5mm 0.482 mm posterior; all 'passes_dislocation_rule': true. Rule text: docs/DECISIONS.md:110-117; PLAN.md:35 ('cage-centre translation <= 1 mm'). find . -name 'constraints*' finds nothing.

fix_options.option: Keep the PI's rigid-body measure (squash is not failure) but add two checks on the LOADED shape: (a) S1 in the deformed state: no cage node beyond the disc-space boundary (inset footprint + tolerance) in any direction, with the posterior side tighter; (b) a rotation limit for the rigid fit (e.g. corner sweep <= 1 mm, i.e. angle * max radius).
fix_options.cost: low (geometry checks on the final state of each window)
fix_options.risk: needs a PI decision on the tolerances

fix_options.option: Fit the rigid motion to the contact-face nodes only, area-weighted, and separately report the largest outward displacement of any material point; define the 'canal clearance zone' geometrically now (before the designer starts).
fix_options.risk: contact-face fit can still hide a lobe that is not in contact; option 1 (a) is still needed

summary_zh: PI 在 10 月 27 日把「滑出」定義為整個 cage 的剛體位移（用所有節點擬合出一個整體平移），上限是任何方向 1 毫米、往後 0.5 毫米。紅隊用一個與 p062 同大小的假 cage 測試，發現這個定義算的是「有多少比例的 cage 在動」，而不是「動的部分移了多遠」。以下情況全部會被判為「沒有滑出」：cage 原地旋轉 10 度，角落移動 1.21 毫米，其中 0.80 毫米往後；後方 10% 的體積往脊髓方向滑 4.5 毫米，報告值只有 0.48 毫米；前方 25% 的體積往食道方向滑出椎間盤空間 3.5 毫米，報告值只有 0.88 毫米。往後的情況要靠另一個「椎管安全區」檢查才能抓到，但這個檢查還沒有定義；往前或往側邊滑出的情況則完全沒有任何規則檢查，因為「不得超出椎間盤空間」只在受力前檢查。設計者可以故意做出「硬的核心抓得很穩、軟的部分鬆鬆的」設計來鑽這個漏洞。另外，計畫文件中的滑出規則還是舊的「cage 中心位移」，而且這兩種定義都還沒有寫成程式。建議：在受力後也檢查 cage 不得超出椎間盤空間，並限制旋轉量；在設計者開始之前把這些檢查寫成程式，並用紅隊的假案例測試（這些案例必須被判為失敗）。
